title: QA: persist demo FLA to disk — save/restore via file_save_fla/file_load_fla on reconnect
description: Each time a new browser connects to the MCP bridge, the editor initializes with a blank document, losing the current QA demo. Fix: after building any QA demo, call file_save_fla and write the base64 to .qa/demo.fla.b64 on disk. At the start of each QA session, call file_load_fla with that file to restore context. This avoids rebuilding from scratch every session. Also investigate whether the editor should auto-persist document state to localStorage or a server-side file between sessions.
